papers.title: Improving Adaptivity via Over-Parameterization in Sequence Models

summary.en: In a sequence model, learning coordinate scales can adapt to the signal and improve rates over fixed scales, with suitable initialization and early stopping.
summary.zh: 在序列模型中，通过学习坐标尺度适应信号结构；在适当初始化与早停条件下，相比固定尺度方法改善收敛速率。

papers.title: Diagonal Over-parameterization in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces as an Adaptive Feature Model: Generalization and Adaptivity

summary.en: A diagonal adaptive kernel learns eigenvalue weights and output coefficients together. The analysis connects feature adaptation, generalization and depth in RKHS regression.
summary.zh: 对角自适应核同时学习特征值权重与输出系数，在 RKHS 回归中分析特征适应、泛化能力和参数化深度之间的关系。

papers.title: Supporting Evidence for the Adaptive Feature Program across Diverse Models

summary.en: The Feature Error Measure (FEM) combines representation and statistical considerations. Specific diagonal and directional models provide evidence that training can improve feature quality under the paper’s assumptions.
summary.zh: Feature Error Measure（FEM）结合表示能力与统计误差。在论文假设下，对角及方向自适应模型为训练改善特征质量提供了理论支持。

papers.title: Alignment-Sensitive Minimax Rates for Spectral Algorithms with Learned Kernels
papers.authors: Dongming Huang · Zhifan Li · Yicheng Li · Qian Lin

tag.zh: 对齐关系与统计复杂度

summary.en: Effective Span Dimension (ESD) measures complexity through the target, spectral order and noise. The work relates alignment to minimax risk and studies when spectral learning reduces this complexity.
summary.zh: 有效跨度维数（ESD）结合目标信号、谱排序与噪声衡量复杂度，将对齐关系联系到极小极大风险，并分析谱学习何时能降低这一复杂度。

en.title: Adaptive Feature | Qian Lin’s Research Program
en.description: From a family of abstract feature-map regressions to fixed, local and global dynamics: an iterative research program connecting neural-network dynamics and generalization.
en.hero_intro: Start with an abstract family of feature-map regressions. Study its dynamics, bring the theory to neural networks, and use their feedback to refine the assumptions—again and again.
en.idea_title:
Begin with a family
of feature-map regressions.
en.idea_intro: The starting point is a family of possible feature maps. Each map, together with output coefficients, defines a regression model. This common language lets us study different learning dynamics before specializing to a concrete neural network.
en.equation_caption: Φ maps inputs into a feature space; β supplies the output coefficients. The choice of family is a modeling hypothesis to be refined through the research cycle.
en.lab_title: A small example within the program.
en.lab_intro: The diagonal sequence model gives one tractable choice of feature-map family: a fixed basis with trainable coordinate scales. Explore its dynamics as a concrete entry point into the broader program.
en.lab_note: This deterministic, finite-dimensional illustration is inspired by the sequence-model paper. It is not a reproduction of its experiments or a guarantee about neural networks. Late fitting can also learn noise.
en.methods_intro: We observe z = θ* + ε in six coordinates, using fixed synthetic noise. The initial weights are λ = (1, 0.55, 0.25, 0.10, 0.04, 0.015).
en.methods_end: The adaptive model uses θj = ajβj, aj(0) = √λj and βj(0) = 0. The scalar equation follows from a² − β² = λ. Curves use fourth-order Runge–Kutta integration; MSE is evaluated against the known synthetic truth, not against the noisy observations.
en.noscript: Enable JavaScript to use the interactive model. The research introduction and paper links remain available below.
en.live: The chart updates when you change a control.
en.research_intro: These works develop specific models, measures of feature quality and statistical results. Together they provide points of contact with the questions above.
en.limits_title: From specific results to a broader theory
en.limits_body: A result for one feature-map family does not settle the full program. Relating abstract dynamics to concrete architectures, testing the assumptions and connecting the resulting trajectories to generalization remain part of the research cycle.
en.about_role:
Associate Professor
Department of Statistics and Data Science
Tsinghua University
en.about_body: Qian Lin studies statistical learning theory, kernel methods, the mathematical foundations of deep learning and high-dimensional statistics. This site focuses on his collaborative work on adaptive features, with Yicheng Li and other coauthors credited in the papers above.
en.guide_body: Read the survey for the broader setting, the NeurIPS paper for a tractable family, and the FEM paper for work on evaluating feature quality. Return to the framework above to place each result in the research program.

en.weight_aria: A bar chart comparing initial and learned feature weights for six coordinates.
en.map_family: An abstract family of feature maps
en.map_feedback: Refine the family’s assumptions and repeat
en.map_goal: Towards a link between dynamics and generalization
family_terms: Which feature maps and structural properties are included?
Which map is held fixed, varied locally, or followed over training?
How does the predictor evolve within, or together with, that representation?
en.dynamics_intro: Use the same abstract regression framework to ask three different questions about learning. Select a view to see what is held fixed, what changes, and what the analysis seeks to explain.

dynamics.label: Fixed
dynamics.title: Hold the feature map fixed.
dynamics.body: Choose a representation Φ₀ and study how regression learns its output coefficients. This gives a reference for understanding what the chosen features already make learnable.
dynamics.question: What can training learn within this representation, and how does its structure shape error?
dynamics.focus: Coefficient dynamics, approximation limits, spectral structure and statistical error.
dynamics.caption: The representation stays fixed while the predictor is trained.

dynamics.label: Local
dynamics.title: Examine changes around a current state.
dynamics.body: Study nearby variations of the feature map and coefficients. Ask how a small update changes predictions and how the two parts respond to one another.
dynamics.question: Which local changes matter for learning, and over what range is the local description useful?
dynamics.focus: Perturbations, response, coupling and the validity of local approximations.
dynamics.caption: Nearby variations reveal the local structure of the learning dynamics.

dynamics.label: Global
dynamics.title: Follow the evolving representation.
dynamics.body: Study the coupled trajectory of features and coefficients over training. Seek an account of how the representation changes and how those changes affect learning.
dynamics.question: How does the full trajectory reshape features, and what does that imply for prediction on new data?
dynamics.focus: Feature evolution, interactions across training time, and their statistical consequences.
dynamics.caption: The analysis follows the learning process beyond a single neighborhood.

en.cycle_intro: The abstract theory and concrete neural networks inform one another. Network behavior helps determine which assumptions capture learning, which need revision, and what the next abstract model should retain.
cycle_steps: State the structure and assumptions that make the regression family meaningful and analyzable.
Develop fixed, local and global descriptions, and identify the questions they can answer.
Establish the correspondence for a chosen architecture and training setting; compare the theoretical picture with network behavior.
Identify agreements, gaps and missing structure. Refine the feature-map family and return to the analysis.
en.cycle_return: Each round of feedback informs the next family of assumptions.
en.goal_title:
Connect how a network learns
with how it generalizes.
en.goal_body: Through repeated abstraction, analysis and feedback, work towards an explanation of how neural-network dynamics shape generalization. The aim is a theory whose assumptions are informed by the networks it seeks to explain.
en.goal_note: This is the program’s guiding objective; individual results apply to the models and assumptions stated in each work.

zh.title: Adaptive Feature | 林乾的自适应特征研究纲领
zh.description: 从一族抽象的特征映射回归出发，研究固定、局部与整体动力学，通过具体神经网络的应用与反馈修正假设，逐步建立动力学与泛化能力的联系。
zh.eyebrow: ADAPTIVE FEATURE · 自适应特征研究纲领
zh.hero_title:
从特征映射族，
走向学习理论。
zh.hero_intro: 从一族抽象的特征映射回归出发，研究其动力学，再将理论用于具体神经网络。由网络获得反馈，逐步修正特征映射族的假设，如此往复。
zh.byline: 林乾与合作者 · 清华大学
zh.figure_label: 抽象模型 ↔ 具体神经网络
zh.idea_title:
先考虑一族
抽象的特征映射回归。
zh.idea_intro: 研究的起点是一族可能的特征映射。每个映射与输出系数共同定义一个回归模型。在这一统一语言中分析不同的学习动力学，再与具体神经网络建立对应。
zh.equation_caption: Φ 将输入映射到特征空间，β 给出输出系数。对特征映射族的选择与假设，在后续研究循环中不断修正。
zh.lab_title: 从一个小模型进入这一框架。
zh.lab_intro: 对角序列模型给出一种可分析的特征映射族：固定基函数，允许坐标尺度随训练变化。下面的示例展示这一具体选择下的动力学。
zh.toy_label: 六维序列模型 · 教学示例
zh.lab_note: 这是依据序列模型论文构造的确定性有限维教学示例，并非论文实验的复现，也不是对一般神经网络的性能保证。训练后期也可能拟合噪声。
zh.methods_intro: 在六个坐标上观测 z = θ* + ε，使用固定的合成噪声。初始权重为 λ = (1, 0.55, 0.25, 0.10, 0.04, 0.015)。
zh.methods_end: 自适应模型使用 θj = ajβj，初始 aj(0) = √λj、βj(0) = 0。标量方程由守恒关系 a² − β² = λ 得到。曲线采用四阶 Runge–Kutta 方法计算；均方误差相对于已知的合成真实信号计算，而不是相对于含噪观测。
zh.methods_source: 序列模型论文第 3.1 节

zh.research_title:
以具体结果，
推进更广的研究纲领。
zh.research_intro: 这些工作分别发展具体模型、特征质量的度量与统计结论，为上述研究问题提供不同的切入点。
zh.limits_title: 从具体结果走向更广的理论
zh.limits_body: 一个特征映射族中的结果仍需放回整个研究循环：与具体网络建立对应、检验并修正假设，再将得到的动力学轨迹与泛化能力联系起来。
zh.about_role:
副教授
清华大学统计与数据科学系
zh.about_body: 林乾的研究涉及统计学习理论、核方法、深度学习的数理基础及高维统计。本网站聚焦其自适应特征研究；相关工作由林乾、李易诚及其他合作者共同完成，完整署名列于各篇论文。
zh.guide_body: 先通过综述了解整体背景，再阅读 NeurIPS 论文中的可分析模型族，以及 FEM 论文对特征质量的研究。随后回到上面的框架，理解每项结果在研究纲领中的位置。

family_terms: 允许哪些特征映射？假设它们具有怎样的结构？
固定哪个映射？考察哪些局部变化？追踪怎样的整体演化？
预测器如何在给定表示下学习，又如何与表示共同演化？
zh.dynamics_intro: 在同一抽象回归框架中，从三个视角提出关于学习的问题。切换下方视角，查看分析中固定什么、考察什么变化，以及希望解释什么。

dynamics.label: 固定
dynamics.title: 固定特征映射，研究回归学习。
dynamics.body: 选定一个表示 Φ₀，分析输出系数的学习过程。这为理解给定特征本身能够支持怎样的学习提供参照。
dynamics.question: 在这一表示下，训练能学到什么？特征结构如何影响误差？
dynamics.focus: 系数动力学、逼近能力、谱结构与统计误差。
dynamics.caption: 表示保持固定，预测器在这一表示下训练。

dynamics.label: 局部
dynamics.title: 在当前状态附近，考察变化与响应。
dynamics.body: 研究特征映射与输出系数在邻域中的变化，考察一次小的更新如何改变预测，以及两部分如何相互影响。
dynamics.question: 哪些局部变化影响学习？局部描述在怎样的范围内有效？
dynamics.focus: 扰动、响应、耦合关系与局部近似的适用范围。
dynamics.caption: 通过邻域中的变化，理解学习动力学的局部结构。

dynamics.label: 整体
dynamics.title: 沿训练过程，追踪表示的演化。
dynamics.body: 研究特征与输出系数共同演化的轨迹，理解表示在整个学习过程中如何改变，以及这些改变带来怎样的统计后果。
dynamics.question: 整体轨迹如何重塑特征？这又如何影响对新数据的预测？
dynamics.focus: 特征演化、不同训练时刻之间的相互作用及其统计后果。
dynamics.caption: 分析从单个邻域延伸到整个学习过程。

zh.cycle_kicker: 03 / 理论与神经网络的往返
zh.cycle_intro: 抽象理论与具体神经网络相互启发。网络中的行为帮助我们判断哪些假设抓住了学习的关键、哪些需要修正，以及下一轮抽象应当保留什么结构。
cycle_steps: 提出特征映射族与假设
明确回归模型族的结构，提出使它有意义、可分析的假设。
研究固定、局部、整体动力学
在统一框架下建立不同尺度的动力学描述，明确各自能够回答的问题。
在选定的网络结构与训练设置中建立对应，比较理论图景与网络行为。
从网络反馈中修正假设
识别吻合之处、差异与缺失的结构，修正特征映射族，再回到动力学分析。
zh.cycle_return: 每一轮反馈，都成为下一轮假设的依据。
zh.goal_title:
建立神经网络动力学
与泛化能力的联系。
zh.goal_body: 通过反复的抽象、分析与反馈，逐步解释神经网络的学习动力学如何影响泛化能力，让理论中的假设不断受到具体网络行为的检验与修正。
zh.goal_note: 这是研究纲领所追求的目标；各项具体结果的适用范围由相应论文中的模型与假设决定。
